description: auditing.md uses 'Eventing' as a common noun for the emission of audit events ('Eventing for each cluster-node is disabled by default; and can be explicitly enabled'), colliding with the Eventing Service - Couchbase's JavaScript-handler compute service, which has nothing to do with auditing. A reader searching the docs for 'Eventing' hits an unrelated product feature, and 'enable Eventing' means two entirely different operations depending on the page.
